content:
The **Red Rocket** is an unmarked location within Morgantown, situated in The Forest region of Appalachia.

A small gas station within the pre-War city, the Red Rocket station is slowly decaying alongside the surrounding buildings.

The original filling station building is filled with detritus along with random loot. There is a campfire outside, alongside abandoned barricades. In front of the station, a blue Pick-R-Up Truck is parked next to the fuel pumps.

The Red Rocket in Morgantown appears in *Fallout 76*.
